subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Which remaining parts of this bundled request should OpenClaw core own now that current main already covers bind precedence, token-fragment guidance, dry-run action previews, and a metadata audit ledger?
rationale: The unresolved work crosses stable setup, auth, update, docs, and audit semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary or output contract as one combined fix.

options.title: Split focused core follow-ups
options.body: Track the remaining systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff reporting, and broader audit coverage separately while leaving already-covered behavior alone.

options.title: Limit this to documentation
options.body: Only add the systemd SecretRef runbook and defer CLI/audit expansion until maintainers see more user demand or reproduction evidence.

options.title: Close as mostly covered
options.body: Treat current main's existing bind precedence, token guidance, dry-run preview, and audit ledger as sufficient and ask for new narrow issues for any concrete gaps.

recommendation.title: Split focused core follow-ups
recommendation.body: Track the remaining systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff reporting, and broader audit coverage separately while leaving already-covered behavior alone.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad work across the docs, update, gateway, and audit surfaces that need the product-boundary decision.
